**[Recall Knowledge - Fiend](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13)): DC 48 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 46 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 43 [Sonnorae](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2571) **Source** [Pathfinder #191: The Destiny War](/Sources.aspx?ID=199) pg. 61 **Perception** +31; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12), [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), painsight, [_true seeing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=344) **Languages** [Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=13), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2), [Goblin](/Languages.aspx?ID=6), [Infernal](/Languages.aspx?ID=19), [Jotun](/Languages.aspx?ID=8), [Shadowtongue](/Languages.aspx?ID=21), [Sylvan](/Languages.aspx?ID=10) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +32, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +31, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +36, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +34, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +36, [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) +34, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +31, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +34, [Torture Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +32 **Str** +7 **Dex** +8 **Con** +5 **Int** +6 **Wis** +7 **Cha** +8 **Items** [_Lens of the Outreaching Eye_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2499), _[The Tyrant](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2516)_ --- **AC** 42 **Fort** +27 **Ref** +32 **Will** +31 +1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=103) **HP** 335 , regeneration 25 (deactivated by good or [silver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=379)) **Immunities** [cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=27) **Weaknesses** good 20, silver 20 **Final Spite** **Trigger** Sonnorae is reduced to 0 Hit Points; **Effect** Sonnorae casts [_wail of the banshee_](/Spells.aspx?ID=361), if it's available, before [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=11). Otherwise, she makes one Strike.
**Unnerving Gaze** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) 30 feet. When a creature ends its turn in the aura, it must succeed at a DC 37 Will save or become [doomed 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9). --- **Speed** 30 feet, fly 30 feet (from [_fly_](/Spells.aspx?ID=125)) **Melee** claw +34 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 3d6+15 slashing plus 2d6 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) **Divine Innate Spells** DC 40, attack +32 - **Cantrips (9th)** [Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Sigil](/Spells.aspx?ID=286) - **4th** [Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) (at will; self only) - **7th** [Command](/Spells.aspx?ID=45), [Crushing Despair](/Spells.aspx?ID=57), [Sound Burst](/Spells.aspx?ID=292) - **8th** [Mind Blank](/Spells.aspx?ID=192), [Plane Shift](/Spells.aspx?ID=222) (at will; to the Harrowed Realm; [Material Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=1); or [Shadow Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=11) only), [Spiritual Epidemic](/Spells.aspx?ID=304) - **9th** [Synesthesia](/Spells.aspx?ID=328), [Wail of the Banshee](/Spells.aspx?ID=361) - **Constant (8th)** [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Fly](/Spells.aspx?ID=125), [True Seeing](/Spells.aspx?ID=344) **Assemble Choir** Sonnorae adds a creature that is affected by her Spirit-Flensing Touch and is within 100 feet to her choir of screams. Sonnorae can have any number of creatures in her choir, although a creature no longer affected by Spirit-Flensing Touch leaves the choir immediately. Creatures in Sonnorae's choir of screams are [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) by each other and Sonnorae, and they can't use [hostile actions](/Rules.aspx?ID=300) toward each other or Sonnorae. If Sonnorae uses a hostile action toward a creature in her choir, it immediately leaves the choir. When Sonnorae casts an innate divine spell, she can cause the effect to originate from any member of her choir instead of herself, using her saving throw DC and attack bonus. **Focus Gaze** ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Enchantment](/Traits.aspx?ID=61), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) Sonnorae stares at a creature she can see within 30 feet. The target must attempt a Will save against Sonnorae's unnerving gaze. In addition, if the creature was already [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9), on a failed save, it sees the skin of its body peel back, making it [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5) for as long as it remains doomed. After attempting this save, the creature is then temporarily immune until the start of Sonnorae's next turn. **Spirit-Flensing Touch** ([Divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), [Necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117)) Sonnorae touches a creature within 10 feet. The target's spirit tears through its organs and flesh and must attempt a DC 40 Will save.
**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected, and is temporarily immune for 24 hours.
**Success** The creature takes 4d6 slashing damage.
**Failure** The creature takes 9d6 damage and is [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) and [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37). As long as the creature remains sickened, it must use one action on its turn to scream in agony.
**Critical Failure** The creature takes 18d6 damage and is sickened 2 and stupefied 2. As long as the creature remains sickened, it must use two actions on its turn to scream in agony.
name: Sonnorae
